conclusion: B remains the baseline because its coordinates and evidence objects remain inspectable, but its NL is not a truth layer. Nested-control continuation, entry aggregation, post-test loops and mutable condition timing require structural protection; prompt-only wording cannot guarantee them.
non_generalization: 36/519 is not an error-rate estimate for the 1609-row corpus; issue selection was diagnostic and the gold cases are function-level.
